name: Hotjar
description: Hotjar is now part of Contentsquare. Its heatmaps, session replay, surveys, and related experience-analytics capabilities have been merged into the Contentsquare platform; new users can no longer create a new Hotjar account.
best_for: Positioned for product, design, and marketing teams who want to "deliver experiences that convert" by understanding user journeys and reducing drop-offs.
features: Integrations with Google Analytics, HubSpot, Optimizely

alternatives.name: Heap
alternatives.description: A product analytics platform that automatically captures every user interaction without manual event tagging.
alternatives.best_for: Product teams wanting automatic data capture for conversion and retention analysis.

alternatives.name: Matomo
alternatives.description: Privacy-first analytics with full data ownership via self-hosted or cloud deployment.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations wanting privacy-compliant analytics without vendor lock-in.

pricing.starting_price: Contentsquare Free is $0; paid Growth, Pro, and Enterprise pricing is not publicly exposed on the current pricing page

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Includes up to 200,000 sessions/month plus heatmaps, session replay, surveys, funnels, and other capabilities.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: 15-day trial for new signups; current public pricing page does not expose a stable numeric price in the retrieved page.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Paid plan; current public pricing page does not expose a stable numeric price in the retrieved page.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Paid enterprise plan; book a demo.

cons: Hotjar is no longer available for new account creation; new users are directed to Contentsquare instead.
The product and plan structure has changed to Contentsquare Free, Growth, Pro, and Enterprise, so older Hotjar pricing comparisons can be misleading.
